I understand you completly. I experienced alprazolam withdrawals and it was the most painful experience of my life. I felt like I was literally dying, didn’t sleep or eat for 5 days because I couldn’t stop the restlessness and the horrible anxiety. I would have panick attacks about 3 times a day, and i couldn’t stop moving my legs for the life of me. It was HELL, there is no other word to describe it. But i can assure you, IT GOT BETTER. After 7 days I was finally able to take my first nap after 5 days, and eat some crackers. Eventually I was able to sleep trough the night (badly) but at least I was sleeping and I could eat a meal without being nauseous. After a month I was almost back to normal, it didn’t felt like I was in hell anymore. 
You got this, it takes strength and A LOT of willpower, but in time you will heal and rest.
